supportEnvelope.basis: Manually selected planted garden ground-support extrema, including close garden beds and paths. L/F/R form the logical composite placement envelope rather than exact corners of the conservatory. Rear envelope point is hidden and inferred by parallelogram closure; approximately +/-10 source px.

W.basis: Visible long foreground garden-boundary direction from leftmost support to foreground garden corner; hand-selected source endpoints, approximately +/-10 px. Averages the planted edge, not every path or dome rib.

D.basis: Visible shorter right foreground garden-boundary direction, reported with increasing source x. Hand-selected source endpoints, approximately +/-10 px. Internal garden/roof details may have local AI perspective differences.

heightReference.basis: Approximate composite vertical ruler for the central conservatory cupola dome, excluding the slender finial. Upper point is visible; the corresponding ground contact below the cupola is occluded and projected near the front conservatory footing. It is a visual height reference, not a measured single visible wall edge or physical camera recovery; about +/-20 px.

notes: Original generated RGBA PNG and runtime copy are byte-identical; no pixel editing, recoloring, masking, mirroring, crop or image warp was applied to either source file.

Half-open alpha>8 crop is [4,90,1446,1017] in the 1448x1086 original. Outer-edge alpha maxima are left=3,right=2,top=0,bottom=1; all four corner alpha values are zero. Existing display-cache low-alpha treatment suppresses the very faint exterior residue.

The broad formal planted garden, axial paths, fountain and conservatory together represent one landmark wonder. It must only be used by the dense-contribution wonder planner; it is not a no-contribution grass/pond alternative.

The source's high cupola would make the footprint undersized if forced to a 1H reference. targetHeight=1.5 retains an approximately 3.691x2.243-cell support envelope inside the 4x3 parcel, with per-side W/D clearance approximately 0.155/0.378 cells. The thin finial extends above that main-feature ruler.

Calibration maps selected garden axes to +0.5/-0.5 and centers the support envelope. Hidden points, circular roof ribs and every fine path are not claimed to share an exactly recovered orthographic physical camera.
